findings.title: Food sickness or fever can be promoted into zombie infection
anchors: UT_immunocompromised.lua reads getApparentInfectionLevel and sets ZOMBIE_INFECTION to that maximum +1; PZ BodyDamage.java:1664-1667 includes FOOD_SICKNESS and ZOMBIE_FEVER.
findings.reproduction_evidence: A non-zombie illness can create a positive zombie-infection stat, affecting death/zombification checks.
findings.missing_proof: No matching in-game Build 42.19/Kahlua session was run for this batch.
findings.recommended_correction: Operate on the intended zombie-infection stat directly and separately model other infection susceptibility.
findings.smallest_regression_test: Tests with only food sickness, only fever, and only zombie infection.
findings.resolution_evidence: The handler now derives zombie infection only from CharacterStat.ZOMBIE_INFECTION. Tests prove isolated food sickness cannot create infection and higher zombie fever cannot replace the underlying infection value.
